7cf6abaf-31f2-4b4a-858c-09b078a7d729.name: World Drumkit
7cf6abaf-31f2-4b4a-858c-09b078a7d729.description:
Sample-free, velocity-sensitive world percussion: 55 strokes, selected by If + MIDI notnum. Custom map; other notes are silent. Short notes retain decay; held notes do not sustain. Four performance controls: Kit tuning, Decay, Brightness, Tabla tuning (independent multiplier; default dayan C4, 261.63 Hz). Synthetic tabla bol approximations; ge bend is preset, not live pressure. Mono voices feed Stereo Output; route to Master.

Deep foundation
- 36: Dunun open; 37: Dunun muted
- 38: Surdo open; 39: Surdo damped

Hand drums
- 40: Djembe bass; 41: tone; 42: slap; 43: muted
- 44: Conga low open; 45: high open; 46: muted; 47: slap
- 48: Bongo low open; 49: high open; 50: rim; 51: muted
- 52: Darbuka doum; 53: tek; 54: ka; 55: slap

Resonant / expressive
- 56: Frame drum centre; 57: rim; 58: muted
- 60: Tabla dayan na; 61: tin; 62: tun; 63: te (dry)
- 64: Tabla bayan ge; 65: ke (muted); 66: pressure bend
- 67: Tabla dha (na + ge); 68: dhin (tin + ge)
- 70: Udu bass air pulse; 71: clay tap; 72: hole slap

Wood / dry accents
- 74: Cajon bass; 75: snare slap; 76: edge
- 77: Claves; 78: Woodblock low; 79: Woodblock high

Metal
- 80: Cowbell open; 81: damped
- 82: Agogo low; 83: Agogo high

Shakers / scrapers / jingles
- 84: Shekere short; 85: accent; 86: long
- 87: Cabasa short; 88: Cabasa long
- 89: Guiro short; 90: Guiro long
- 91: Tambourine hit; 92: shake; 93: damped

f3922374-6038-4c76-bf75-f8bf1c2f8a30.name: Rubber Core FM Bass
f3922374-6038-4c76-bf75-f8bf1c2f8a30.description: One 1:2 FM pair plus a sine at the played fundamental. Growl fades with the envelope to a sustained rubbery body. Suggested MIDI notes 28–55. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

006e4f9e-8822-4dc6-bec3-9d806c689672.name: Undertow Motion Pad
006e4f9e-8822-4dc6-bec3-9d806c689672.description: Dark triangle and PWM pulse pad. Sine LFO moves pulse width from 0.32 to 0.68 and filter cutoff from 70% to 130% of Tone. Motion is Hz, not tempo sync. Suggested MIDI notes 43–79. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

e7dae45d-3aca-4f67-bc7d-fef3ac29e4b7.name: Lake Bamboo Flute
e7dae45d-3aca-4f67-bc7d-fef3ac29e4b7.description: Breath-first bamboo flute with velocity-driven blowing pressure. Air starts immediately, then the bore tone builds. Soft/medium notes settle on the played pitch; firm attacks briefly overblow and fall back; hard blows favor the octave while held. Ground and octave families overlap and exchange strength irregularly near the register boundary, then stabilize away from it. Unequal resonance memory preserves the lower tone through transitions. A recording-informed modal-envelope approximation, not a full air-jet simulation. Best E3–E5, playable to D6. Five compatible controls and dry Stereo Output. Gapless monophonic legato: connected notes preserve the breath, bore and vibrato; pitch changes immediately and velocity follows with a 10 ms half-time. Gaps articulate a new phrase.

competing_modes::a.expression: mean + (.78 * 4 * mean * (1 - mean) + .48 * onset * velocity * velocity) * (.78 * pulse + .22 * scatter)

bore_2::amp.expression: env * (1 + pressure) * (0.3 * ground * (.30 + .70 * velocity) * bloom * (1 + colour) / (1 + (pitch * 1 / 1800) * (pitch * 1 / 1800)) + 0.48 * upper)

bore_7::amp.expression: env * (1 + pressure) * (0.007 * ground * (.30 + .70 * velocity) * bloom * (1 + colour) / (1 + (pitch * 1 / 950) * (pitch * 1 / 950)))

1d1ae919-b144-484b-b780-fb197bdb4aba.name: Prism FM Pluck
1d1ae919-b144-484b-b780-fb197bdb4aba.description: A harmonic 1:3 FM pair with a bright onset that softens into a glassy pluck. Release controls the tail after key-up; decay controls held notes. Suggested MIDI notes 48–84. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

edec9fff-768b-4de1-b892-53eb4249b2bf.name: Reverb Effect
edec9fff-768b-4de1-b892-53eb4249b2bf.description: Stereo reverb effect, uses inleta channel names "left" and "right".

979b006c-d2a5-47c1-836c-9f3f30453ddf.name: Analog Drumkit
979b006c-d2a5-47c1-836c-9f3f30453ddf.description: 17 velocity-sensitive, sample-free analog percussion voices. GM notes: 35 kick, 36 distorted kick, 37 side stick, 38 snare, 39 clap, 40 electric snare, 41/43/45/47/48/50 low-to-high toms, 42 closed hat, 46 open hat, 49 crash, 51 ride, 54 tambourine. Existing sounds and settings retained. BD snappiness, shared hat tuning and snare tuning default to 1 (original sound). Each added voice has its own characteristic control. Finite one-shot tails survive short note-offs; unmapped notes are silent. Stereo output.

hihat_open_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

hihat_closed_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

tambourine_pan::asig.expression: (s0 + s1 + s2 + s3 + s4 + s5 + s6) * amplitude

crash_mix::a.expression: metal * body + wash * wash_env * 0.65 + air * fizz * 0.20 + stick * strike * 0.3

ride_mix::a.expression: metal * body + wash * wash_env * 0.55 * brightness + air * fizz * 0.16 * brightness + stick * strike * 0.28 + ping * ping_env

d6a771a3-056b-4a69-9ddc-0abaed75603b.name: EBM DW — Sequencer Bass
d6a771a3-056b-4a69-9ddc-0abaed75603b.description: Lean dry pulse/saw bass for short external sixteenth-note sequences. Velocity changes filter brightness; no built-in sequencer. Suggested MIDI 28–60. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

fac3faea-086f-448c-9581-8692bc30cca1.name: EBM DW — Glass Bell
fac3faea-086f-448c-9581-8692bc30cca1.description: Cold glass bell with an inharmonic two-operator FM strike, decaying brightness and dark echoes/reverb. Suggested MIDI 48–88. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.
